test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under Phase I of Mission COVID Suraksha, the Government of India had sanctioned an amount of _________, in November 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹900 crores**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Government of India sanctioned **₹900 crores** under Phase I of Mission COVID Suraksha in November 2020.
 
• Mission COVID Suraksha is an initiative aimed at accelerating the development and production of indigenous COVID-19 vaccines in India.
 
• This mission is part of the third stimulus package, Atmanirbhar Bharat 3.
